citations.claim: First violation: EW yellow lasted only 2s vs required 4s; step 108 shows all-red before NS
EW yellow started by step 106 while NS waited 60+s with queue
EW still green at step 104-105 before early termination

counterfactual.change: Set actuated false (fixed-time); same steps/seeds/rates/timings. Predicted full yellow honoured because no recall preemption truncates yellow.

explanation: Actuated recall for long-waiting NS (N wait 60+s, queue 14 at step 104) appears to preempt EW phase and truncate EW yellow to 2s (yellow at steps 106-107 only, red by 108) below required 4s. Fixed-time version of same scenario shows no violation.
vision_note: In tile 105 the signals show green while long blue vehicle queues wait on the red approaches. The greens turn yellow in tiles 106-107 and are already red in tile 108, so the yellow is displayed for only two seconds.
